title: Quarter Volume Library Prep Step 7: PCR Enrichment
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.

steps.title: Set labware engage height
steps.instruction: Enter the engage height for the custom magnetic‑module labware as a protocol parameter before running the protocol.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Using the OT app, set the temperature module to 4 °C and allow it to pre‑cool before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes
steps.instruction: Confirm that all required reagents are present on the deck in sufficient volume; the protocol will alert you if any are missing.

steps.title: Dispense i7 indexes
steps.instruction: With the p20 multi‑channel pipette, use one tip on the rear‑most channel to dispense i7 indexes from the selected row into the appropriate columns of the PCR plate.

steps.title: Dispense and transfer Q5 Mastermix
steps.instruction: First, use the p300 multi‑channel pipette with one tip on the rear‑most channel to dispense Q5 Mastermix into column 6 of the reagent plate. Then, using the p20 multi‑channel pipette (one tip rear‑most channel), transfer the Mastermix from column 6 to the designated columns of the PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Dispense Q5 Mastermix into column 6 of reagent plate with p300 multi (1 tip, rear‑most channel).
Transfer Mastermix from column 6 to PCR plate columns with p20 multi (1 tip, rear‑most channel).

steps.title: Transfer i5 indexes
steps.instruction: Using the p20 multi‑channel pipette with one tip on the rear‑most channel, transfer i5 indexes from the selected column to the appropriate columns of the PCR plate.

steps.title: Transfer eluted sample
steps.instruction: With the p20 multi‑channel pipette (one tip rear‑most channel), move the eluted sample from the magnetic module plate columns into the corresponding columns of the PCR plate.
